plugins.name: ribbon
plugins.description: A slim band above the prompt: context fill, session cost, the prompt cache, and buttons to clear, compact or reload the loaded project.

plugins.name: commits-table
plugins.description: Adds or refreshes a ## Commits table in a GitHub PR description: each commit's SHA linked to it in the PR, its area, and one line written from its diff.

plugins.name: slang
plugins.description: A French slang register (verlan, banlieue argot, Gen Z) for conversational replies only, at levels 0 to 3; artifacts stay professional.
